Taylor Fritz: Taylor Fritz enters this match following a quarter-final run in Stockholm where he defeated Cameron Norrie, his fourth consecutive quarter-final appearance. However, his recent form also includes a heartbreaking defeat at the Paris Masters, where he squandered multiple match points against Carlos Alcaraz to miss out on qualification for the ATP Finals.
Holger Rune: Holger Rune recently returned to Stockholm—the scene of his horrific and "scary" long-term Achilles injury that ended his previous season—with a statement win. Showing strong current form, he has since defeated Miomir Kecmanovic to reach his 40th career quarter-final.
Ugo Humbert: Ugo Humbert enters good form at the Stockholm Open, successfully kick-starting his title bid by fighting back to avoid an upset against Adolfo Daniel Vallejo despite surviving nine breaks. Following this opening win, he has advanced to the second round where he is set up for a last-16 clash against qualifier Borna Gojo.
Lorenzo Musetti: Lorenzo Musetti enters this match in strong form, highlighted by a notable victory over Alexander Zverev at the Paris Masters—though he was subsequently defeated in the Round of 16 by Luca Van Assche. Continuing his momentum, Musetti has since advanced to the quarterfinals of the Stockholm Open with an easy win over Toby Samuel. There are no mentions of injuries or withdrawals in the recent headlines.
